mapper.insert: insert into account( account_no, account_id, account_password, account_name, account_phone, account_birth, account_status, account_type ) values ( #{accountNo}, #{accountId}, #{accountPassword}, #{accountName}, #{accountPhone}, #{accountBirth}, #{accountStatus}, #{accountType} )
mapper.select: select count(*) from account where account_id = #{accountId}

SELECT a.account_no, a.account_type, e.employee_no, s.student_no, p.parent_no FROM account a LEFT JOIN employee e ON a.account_no = e.account_no LEFT JOIN student s ON a.account_no = s.account_no LEFT JOIN parent p ON a.account_no = p.account_no WHERE a.account_no = #{accountNo}
mapper.update: update account set account_password = #{accountPassword}, account_utime = systimestamp where account_no = #{accountNo}
